    1. call(TReq)

Interface Model<TReq extends ModelRequest<?>, TRes extends ModelResponse<?>>

Type Parameters:
TReq - AI 模型请求的泛型类型
TRes - AI 模型响应的泛型类型
All Known Subinterfaces:
ChatModel, DocumentEmbeddingModel, EmbeddingModel, ImageModel, ModerationModel, TextToSpeechModel, TranscriptionModel
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractEmbeddingModel, AnthropicChatModel, BedrockCohereEmbeddingModel, BedrockProxyChatModel, BedrockTitanEmbeddingModel, DeepSeekChatModel, ElevenLabsTextToSpeechModel, GoogleGenAiChatModel, GoogleGenAiTextEmbeddingModel, MistralAiChatModel, MistralAiEmbeddingModel, MistralAiModerationModel, OllamaChatModel, OllamaEmbeddingModel, OpenAiAudioSpeechModel, OpenAiAudioTranscriptionModel, OpenAiChatModel, OpenAiEmbeddingModel, OpenAiImageModel, OpenAiModerationModel, PostgresMlEmbeddingModel, StabilityAiImageModel, TransformersEmbeddingModel, VertexAiMultimodalEmbeddingModel, VertexAiTextEmbeddingModel
public interface Model<TReq extends ModelRequest<?>, TRes extends ModelResponse<?>>
Model 接口提供了一个通用的 API，用于调用人工智能模型。该接口旨在通过抽象发送请求和接收响应的过程来处理与各种类型人工智能模型的交互。该接口使用 Java 泛型来适应不同类型的请求和响应，从而增强了在不同人工智能模型实现中的灵活性和适应性。

0.8.0
